versions.content: ReadDataByPeriodicIdentifier Type: valid Description: The Diagnostic Extract shall support the configuration of UDS service 0x2A (ReadDataByPeriodicIdentifier). Rationale: The service allows for requesting the periodic transmission of diagnostic data by the server according to the definition of a periodic data identifier. Use Case: The user wants to get access to diagnostic data that is transmitted periodically without the necessity to request each transmission individually. Dependencies: – Supporting Material: More information about this diagnostic service can be found in the respective ISO specification [2].
